title: Vapes restricted to pharmacy supply
summary: From 1 July 2024 vapes may be supplied only by pharmacies for therapeutic use; imports of disposable and non-therapeutic vapes were banned earlier in 2024.

instruments.title: Therapeutic Goods and Other Legislation Amendment (Vaping Reforms) Act 2024

direction_rationale: Closing non-pharmacy channels removes tobacconists and convenience stores from a market and may shift supply to illicit sellers.

industries.name: Pharmaceutical, Cosmetic and Toiletry Goods Retailing

comparison: State rules on vape supply differ (not checked)

verified.notes: Date from the TGA's media release; import ban dates (1 January and 1 March 2024) not checked.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 18 October 2026 (legislation gap scan, docs/legislation_gap_scan.md) from the sources cited. Not yet checked by a person: verify dates, industries and the direction hypothesis before use.

assessment.summary: Vapes may be sold only by pharmacies for therapeutic use, after bans on imports of disposable and non-therapeutic vapes. It closes other legal retail channels and may push supply to illicit sellers.

marks.reason: Restricts lawful supply to pharmacies, closing the market to other retailers.

assessment.confidence_note: Public health benefits, the reason for the policy, are not weighed here.
